dct_alternative_sm: Données sur l'éclat de surface de l'expédition 2019 de l'Année internationale du saumon dans le golfe de l'Alaska
dct_description_sm: Sea surface radiance (LT(λ)), sky radiance (Ls(λ)), and total irradiance (Ed(λ)) data collected using a set of hyperspectral radiometers. These data were collected as part of the International Year of the Salmon (IYS) Gulf of Alaska High Seas Expedition conducted in February and March 2019, to further improve the understanding of factors impacting salmon early marine winter survival.
Résumé nécessaire du fournisseur de données
dct_title_s: Surface Radiance Data from the 2019 Gulf of Alaska International Year of the Salmon Expedition
